content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Winston-Salem

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and measurable project-management experience. Review PMI's specific prerequisites—typically a secondary degree plus documented hours leading projects—to ensure you qualify before enrolling. Granite PM Academy staff can clarify whether your background meets the standard.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Instruction
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Boot Camp. Our Winston-Salem cohorts deliver the PMI-mandated 35 contact hours in a structured, accelerated format, allowing you to study project-management frameworks, risk, procurement, and stakeholder management alongside local professionals.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your training hours, submit your official PMI PMP application and required exam fee through PMI's online portal. Granite PM Academy will guide you through documentation and submission to ensure your application moves forward without delays.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and instructor office hours—to solidify your knowledge. Schedule your exam at a PMI-approved testing center in the Winston-Salem area and take the computerized PMP assessment when you feel ready.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, commit to the standard three-year renewal cycle by earning professional development units (PDUs) through ongoing training, volunteer work, or published contributions. Granite PM Academy offers continuing-education courses to help you stay current and renew on schedule.
